single_factor.release_classification: Dominant body-frame gravity axis at release is negative X with magnitude at least 0.75. Recompute per environment on each release; clear on reset.
single_factor.where: Per-sample clipped PPO actor surrogate only, divided by active sample weights in each minibatch. All other active controls have weight 1. Inactive controls never contribute.
single_factor.reason: Supine missed the formal gate and 13 of the 15 candidate failures already had native head-leg contact by 3.0 s. Test greater credit assignment in that interval with the existing dense reward.
single_factor.shared: Identical physical state distribution, actor and critic checkpoints, rewards, advantage normalization, replay coefficient 0.01, KL limits, projection, evaluation, and training budget. No new observation or runtime branch.

proposed_first_pair.seed_note: The prior S3 persistent-contact comparison already used training seed 44. Seed 45 starts a new getup training stream from the retained parent.
proposed_first_pair.video: Use the existing visible VS Code task, default live viewer off. Record first complete 8 s action and schedule actual action-boundary clips approximately every 180 s. Retain partial clips with true duration. Record full 11 s evaluation views.
proposed_first_pair.early_stop: Fail closed on interface, finite-state, loss/KL or inherited successful-input drift limits. Control first. Stop and review if engineering tripwire prevents an equal-budget comparison. No retry or extension.

evaluation.admission: Retain all original 95% gates, both holds and per-pose release coverage. The weighted arm must also gain at least six actual-supine successes against the matched training control without losing aggregate successes or actual-supine successes against the fixed parent. A control that already passes is considered for independent confirmation first.
evaluation.confirmation: A development pass admits separate seed confirmation only. Record the shared parent in any comparison of multiple continuation seeds. Random falls, continuous transitions and heldout acceptance remain separate.

required_preflight: Verify the retained PT and ONNX by SHA-256. Restore both networks and Adam state with CPU and actual GPU zero-step checks before learning.
Prove exact release mask parity on archived observations/physical quaternions, including ties, resets and first/last active controls.
Prove all-one loss/actor update parity against the original AnchorPPO; show a mixed mask changes only the actor path on identical data.

Verify four-pose reset allocation, model dimensions, HOME, raw history, projection, logging, recorder, startup RNG and matched initial state. Freeze sources and exact caps before creating the visible task.
